_instructions: Instantiate every field from actual current sources. A template, copied example, declared hash or fake authority is never proof or user acceptance. No fixed phase count or specialist roster is required. Separate public entry count, skill count, phase graph and execution authority. Do not list the final ZIP or self-checksum as an expected artifact inside itself. For selected app/chatbot/agent_skill components, declare specialist_route with stable selector and handoff_artifact_id pointing to an expected component_handoff JSON artifact. Mixed app/chatbot plans also name shared_contract_artifact_ids. A planned specialist dependency is not an invocation or product execution grant.
